name: Birth certificate (state file) number
notes: Assigned at birth registration. Used to seed CalKIDS newborn accounts. Not carried forward by any education system.

name: CalKIDS account ID
scope: Statewide, newborns since July 2022 and low-income public school students
notes: Created from CDPH birth data (newborns) and CALPADS SSID (students). One of the few identifiers created at birth that later meets an education record.

name: Medi-Cal Client Index Number (CIN)
scope: Statewide, anyone ever enrolled in Medi-Cal or CalFresh/CalWORKs
notes: Shared across Medi-Cal, CalFresh and CalWORKs through MEDS and CalSAWS. Covers roughly half of California children. Not shared with ECE or schools except through direct-certification matches.

name: WIC participant ID
scope: Pregnant and postpartum people, infants and children under 5

name: CAIR immunization record ID
scope: Children and adults with reported immunizations
notes: Schools and child care sites can look up records to verify entry immunizations, but no ID is stored in education data.

name: DDS Unique Client Identifier (UCI)
scope: Early Start (0 to 3) and regional center consumers
notes: Program-specific. DDS joined C2C in 2024, so DDS records are now matched into the P20W data set by person-matching rather than a shared ID.

name: CWS/CMS client ID
scope: Children in child welfare and foster care
notes: Matched weekly to CALPADS by CDE to flag foster youth.

name: Local child or family case ID
issuer: Individual ECE contractors, Head Start grantees, First 5 commissions
notes: There is no statewide child identifier in early learning. Each contractor assigns its own. This is the single largest break in the chain.

name: Statewide Student Identifier (SSID)
scope: Public TK-12 students, plus some LEA-run preschool and special education preschool
notes: 10-digit ID assigned at first public school enrollment. Encouraged but not required in CAPSDAC (LEA-run state preschool). Collected by CCCApply and CaliforniaColleges.edu, which helps C2C matching.

name: Statewide Educator Identifier (SEID)
notes: Links staff assignments in CALPADS to CTC credential records for TAMO.

name: CTC credential / permit document records
scope: Credential and Child Development Permit holders
notes: Child Development Permits for ECE staff live here, but ECE employment is not reported back, so the ECE workforce is invisible after the permit is issued.

name: CCCID / college student ID
issuer: California Community Colleges (CCCApply and each college)
notes: CCCID is statewide for applicants. Each college also assigns a local ID. SSN is collected but optional.

name: Social Security Number
scope: Most residents; missing for many immigrant students and young children in non-benefit programs
notes: The de facto workforce key (UI wages, FAFSA, CalJOBS). Absent or optional in most education records. Relying on it leaves out undocumented students and anyone who withholds it.

name: CA Dream Act Application ID / ITIN
scope: Undocumented and mixed-status students applying for state aid
notes: Lets CSAC serve students without an SSN, but these students drop out of SSN-based wage matching.

name: EDD employer account number / FEIN
notes: Approved as a new C2C P20W data point from EDD in May 2026 (employer ID and name), which opens industry analysis.

name: C2C person ID (master data management)
scope: Everyone matched across C2C data partners
notes: Internal ID produced by probabilistic matching of name, birth date, SSN where present, and partner IDs. Never shared outward. This is the closest thing California has to a lifelong learner ID.
